title: Roaming charge on a plan sold as inclusive
context: Account 4471-8820, consumer mobile, monthly plan advertised as including roaming in 30 listed countries. The September bill carries a roaming data charge of 62.40. The agent can see the country the usage was billed under, can waive up to 75.00 per account per year, and cannot edit the plan terms.
customer_turns: My September bill has a roaming data charge of sixty-two forty on account 4471-8820. I was told this plan includes roaming in thirty countries.
I was in a country your own list names, and I have boarding passes for both directions. I never left it during the billing period.
I need to know today whether that sixty-two forty is coming off. If it is not, tell me plainly before the payment date.
resolution_space: Waive the 62.40 charge under the annual waiver allowance
Open a billing investigation with a stated turnaround and hold collection
Decline the waiver and explain the billed country and usage record
Escalate to the billing review team

title: Autopay debited twice in one cycle
context: Account 7702-3391. The system shows two successful direct-debit collections of 48.00 on the same date. The agent can confirm both collections, can request a refund that takes five to seven banking days, and cannot reverse a debit instantly.
customer_turns: Two payments of forty-eight went out of my bank on the same day for account 7702-3391. My bill is forty-eight, not ninety-six.
A credit on next month's bill does not help me. The second debit put my current account overdrawn and the bank has charged me for that.
Can you send the forty-eight back to the account it came from, and on what date will it land? I need a date for my bank.
resolution_space: Raise a refund to the originating bank account with a stated settlement window
Apply the duplicate amount as a credit to the next bill
Decline and refer the customer to their bank to recall the debit
Escalate to the payments team

title: Promotional discount ended without notice
context: Account 1188-6504. A 12-month promotional discount of 15.00 per month expired in August; the bill rose from 34.00 to 49.00. Notice of the end date appears in the original order confirmation. The agent can offer a current retention promotion of 10.00 per month for six months and cannot reinstate an expired promotion.
customer_turns: My bill on account 1188-6504 jumped from thirty-four to forty-nine this month with no warning I ever saw. Nobody wrote to me and nobody called.
I have searched every email from you since last year and found no reminder. A line in an order confirmation a year ago is not notice anyone would find.
I want to know whether you will put the price back to thirty-four, or whether forty-nine is final. I need that before I decide anything.
resolution_space: Apply the current retention promotion of 10.00 per month for six months
Confirm the standard rate and point to the disclosed end date
Offer a one-off goodwill credit for the first uplifted month
Escalate to the retention team

title: Number porting stuck in progress
context: Port request PAC-40771, submitted nine days ago. The standard transfer is one working day. The status shows rejected by the losing provider for a name mismatch. The agent can resubmit with corrected details and cannot complete the port unilaterally.
customer_turns: I asked to move my number to you nine days ago with code PAC-40771. Your app still says in progress and my old provider says it is finished with.
Nobody has told me anything was wrong. If a name did not match, you had that detail from my application on day one and could have asked.
Tell me what is actually needed from me and when the number will move. I have customers ringing the old line and need a reliable date.
resolution_space: Resubmit the port with corrected details and confirm the new transfer date
Request an expedited transfer window from the losing provider
Cancel the port and reissue a fresh request
Escalate to the porting team

title: Refund for a returned router not credited
context: Return RTN-30948. The router was received back at the warehouse twenty-three days ago. The refund of 89.00 was approved but not released. The agent can push the refund for release within two working days and can credit the account instantly instead.
customer_turns: I returned a router under RTN-30948 and your warehouse signed for it twenty-three days ago. The eighty-nine pounds has never come back to me.
I was told fourteen days when I sent it. That window closed over a week ago, and the app simply shows the return as complete with nothing attached.
I need the eighty-nine pounds released to my card with a date, or a straight answer that it is not coming back that way. Which is it?
resolution_space: Release the refund to the original card with a stated settlement date
Credit 89.00 to the account balance immediately instead
Reopen the return case for warehouse confirmation
Escalate to the finance team

title: Fibre upgrade stalled at pending survey
context: Order FIB-20553, placed five weeks ago, status pending survey. Survey bookings in this postcode are quoted at six weeks. The agent can flag the order for survey prioritisation, can offer a 10.00 monthly credit while the upgrade is outstanding, and cannot guarantee a survey date.
customer_turns: My fibre upgrade, order FIB-20553, has said pending survey for five weeks. Nothing has changed and nobody has contacted me to arrange anything.
I am already paying the higher fibre price, which started the month I ordered. So I am paying for a service that has not been installed.
I want either a survey date or the billing put back to what I paid before. Tell me which one you can actually do today.
resolution_space: Flag the order for survey prioritisation and give a revised estimate
Apply the monthly credit until the upgrade completes
Revert billing to the pre-upgrade rate and hold the order
Escalate to the provisioning team

title: Data works but calls fail
context: Mobile number 0771-336-4408. Data sessions register normally; voice registration fails on the home network and succeeds when roaming. This pattern matches a provisioning record error. The agent can reprovision the line, which takes up to two hours, and can issue a temporary divert.
customer_turns: Calls from my mobile 0771-336-4408 fail instantly with a network error. Data is completely fine, so messaging apps and email work without any problem.
It started the day my new contract began. It also works normally abroad, which makes me think something is wrong at your end rather than my handset.
Please fix the calling or give me some way to receive calls today. I have a hospital appointment on Thursday and they will ring this number.
resolution_space: Reprovision the line and confirm a completion window
Set up a temporary call divert to another number
Issue a replacement SIM in case of SIM-side failure
Escalate to the core network team

title: Wi-Fi speed far below the plan
context: Account 5527-9034 on a 500 Mbps fibre plan. Router statistics show 480 Mbps at the port and 40 Mbps over Wi-Fi in the customer's room. The agent can send a mesh extender free of charge and can book an in-home visit chargeable at 65.00.
customer_turns: I pay for five hundred megabits on account 5527-9034 and get about forty in the room where I work. By the router it measures full speed.
The house is stone-built and the router sits at the opposite end from my desk, which I cannot move. I have already changed the wireless channel.
What can you give me to fix this, and does it cost anything? I need the number before I agree to anything being sent or booked.
resolution_space: Send a mesh extender free of charge with setup instructions
Book a chargeable in-home visit at the quoted price
Reconfigure the router band settings remotely
Escalate to the broadband performance team

title: Noise on the landline after a storm
context: Landline 0161-224-7781. Line tests show high resistance consistent with water ingress in external cabling after storm damage; the area has an open mass-outage record. The agent can attach the line to the mass fault and cannot book an individual engineer while it is open.
customer_turns: My landline 0161-224-7781 has loud crackling on every call since the storm last week. I can barely hear the other person and they say the same.
My neighbour on the same street has the identical problem and was told an engineer would come. This is our only line and my mother calls daily.
So do I get my own engineer, or am I waiting for the area repair? Please tell me which, and roughly when it will be fixed.
resolution_space: Attach the line to the open area fault and give the published restoration estimate
Offer call diversion to a mobile while the fault is open
Apply a service credit for the affected days
Escalate to the network repair team

title: Cancelling a television add-on package
context: Account 4408-7752 with a 22.00 monthly television add-on inside a 12-month minimum term, five months elapsed. The agent can cancel with an exit charge of 40.00, can downgrade to a 9.00 tier with no charge, and cannot cancel free of charge.
customer_turns: I would like to cancel the television package on account 4408-7752. We barely use it since the children went back to school and it costs twenty-two monthly.
I was not aware it carried its own twelve-month term when I added it by phone. I thought it was a month-to-month extra alongside the broadband.
What is the cheapest way out of it for me? Give me the options with the actual costs and I will pick one now.
resolution_space: Cancel the add-on and apply the exit charge
Downgrade to the lower tier with no exit charge
Suspend the add-on until the minimum term ends
Escalate to the retention team

title: Locked out of the self-service portal
context: Account 7248-1130. The online profile is locked after repeated failed sign-ins. The agent can trigger a password reset to the registered email, can unlock after identity verification, and cannot read or set the password.
customer_turns: I cannot get into my online account for 7248-1130. It says my profile is locked, and the reset link it sends me does nothing when clicked.
The registered email is one I still use and the reset messages do arrive. The link opens a page saying the token is invalid, on two browsers.
I need access today to download a bill for my accountant. Either fix the reset or send me the bill another way, whichever is faster.
resolution_space: Unlock the profile after identity verification and reissue a reset
Send the requested bill by email or post directly
Re-register the profile against the same account
Escalate to the digital support team

title: Account still in a former housemate's name
context: Account 5590-4417 registered to a previous occupant who has moved out. The current occupant pays the bill from their own bank account. A change of account holder requires the named holder's consent or proof of tenancy plus twelve months of payment history.
customer_turns: The broadband at my address, account 5590-4417, is still in my old housemate's name. She moved out a year ago and I have paid every bill.
She has moved abroad and I cannot reliably reach her, so getting her to call you is unrealistic. I do have my tenancy agreement and bank statements.
Can you put the account in my name using what I have, or is her consent the only route? Tell me which, and what to send.
resolution_space: Transfer the account on proof of tenancy and payment history
Require the named holder's consent before any transfer
Close the account and open a new one in the occupant's name
Escalate to the account ownership team

title: Security code going to an old number
context: Account 6032-7714. Two-factor codes are sent to a mobile number the customer no longer controls. Changing the security number normally requires a code sent to that number. The agent can verify by account history questions and update the number after verification.
customer_turns: Every time I sign in to account 6032-7714 you send a code to a mobile number I gave up two years ago. I cannot access that number.
To change the security number your website wants a code sent to that same old number, which I cannot receive. It is a loop I cannot escape.
Please change the number on the account to my current mobile. Tell me what you need to prove who I am and let us do it.
resolution_space: Verify by account history questions and update the security number
Require an in-store identity check before changing the number
Send a verification letter to the registered address
Escalate to the account security team

title: Price dropped the day after purchase
context: Order R-523114, placed on the 3rd at 180.00; the same item listed at 144.00 on the 4th. The published price-promise window is fourteen days and covers price reductions on the retailer's own site. The agent can refund the 36.00 difference.
customer_turns: I bought a coat on order R-523114 for a hundred and eighty pounds, and the next day your site had it at a hundred and forty-four.
I looked for your price promise and the page mentions matching other retailers, but it is not obvious whether your own reductions count for something already ordered.
Can you refund the thirty-six pound difference, or do I have to return it and buy it again? Tell me which is quicker.
resolution_space: Refund the price difference under the price promise
Cancel and reorder at the lower price
Decline and explain the promise terms
Escalate to the customer care team

title: Subscription box charged after a skip request
context: Subscription S-77401. The customer requested a skip for October through the app; the log shows the request submitted eleven hours after the cut-off. The 39.00 box has shipped. The agent can refund on return, can waive return postage, and cannot recall a shipped box.
customer_turns: I asked to skip October on subscription S-77401 and you charged and shipped it anyway. Thirty-nine pounds went out on the same day I made the request in the app.
The app did not warn me that I had missed a cut-off. It accepted the skip and showed October as skipped on the schedule screen afterwards.
I do not want the box. Tell me whether I get the thirty-nine pounds back and whether I am paying to send it to you.
resolution_space: Refund on return with prepaid return postage
Refund without requiring the box to be returned
Uphold the charge and skip the following month instead
Escalate to the subscriptions team

title: Refund not received after a returned parcel
context: Return RET-22890, received back at the warehouse fifteen days ago. The published refund window is ten working days from receipt. The refund of 74.50 is queued but not processed. The agent can expedite it to two working days.
customer_turns: I returned a parcel under RET-22890 and your warehouse scanned it in fifteen days ago. The seventy-four fifty has not come back.
Your policy says ten working days from receipt, which has now passed. The tracking clearly shows it was signed for, so there is no question about whether you have it.
Give me a date for the refund. If you cannot give me one, say so and I will take it up with my card provider instead.
resolution_space: Expedite the refund with a stated settlement date
Refund as store credit immediately
Reinspect the return before releasing the refund
Escalate to the returns team

title: Click-and-collect order not ready at the store
context: Order R-552017 for collection at the Riverside store, marked ready to collect. Store stock shows the item allocated but not located. The agent can reallocate to another store six miles away for same-day collection or convert to home delivery for the next day.
customer_turns: I drove to the Riverside store for click-and-collect order R-552017 after your ready-to-collect email. The desk spent twenty minutes looking and could not find it anywhere.
They told me to contact you rather than waiting. I do not have a car tomorrow, so going back to that store is not something I can easily do.
What are my options that do not involve me returning to Riverside? Give me them with times and costs, and I will choose now.
resolution_space: Reallocate to the nearby store for same-day collection
Convert to next-day home delivery at no charge
Refund the order in full
Escalate to the store operations team

title: Pre-order release date passed with no update
context: Pre-order R-571339 for an item whose release date passed eight days ago. The supplier has moved the release by three weeks and no customer notification was sent. The agent can cancel with a full refund, can hold the pre-order, and cannot advance the supplier date.
customer_turns: I pre-ordered an item on R-571339 for release on the second. That date passed over a week ago and I have heard absolutely nothing from you since.
The money was taken at the time of the pre-order, so you have had a hundred and twenty pounds of mine for two months with nothing to show for it.
Tell me the real release date and whether I can cancel and get the money back now. I want both answers before I decide.
resolution_space: Cancel the pre-order and refund in full
Hold the pre-order and confirm the revised release date
Offer a goodwill credit for the delay and keep the order
Escalate to the buying team

title: Appliance failed within the warranty period
context: Order R-580226, a kettle delivered four months ago with a two-year warranty. The fault described matches a known batch defect under a manufacturer advisory. The agent can arrange a direct replacement without inspection under that advisory.
customer_turns: The kettle from order R-580226 has stopped heating. It was delivered four months ago and it powers on, lights up, and then simply never boils the water.
I have tried it on two different sockets and descaled it as the manual says. Nothing changed, and there is a faint burning smell when it runs now.
I would like a replacement rather than a repair. Can you do that, and do I need to send the old one back first?
resolution_space: Send a direct replacement under the manufacturer advisory
Arrange collection and inspection before replacing
Refund the item in full
Escalate to the product safety team

title: Business account applied to the wrong orders
context: Business account B-11204 with net pricing. Four recent orders were placed under the customer's personal account at retail prices, costing 96.00 more in total. Policy allows retrospective repricing within thirty days; the orders are eighteen days old.
customer_turns: Four recent orders went through on my personal login instead of the business account B-11204. That means I paid retail rather than our agreed net prices.
The difference across the four is about ninety-six pounds, and our finance team will not accept invoices that do not show the business pricing and our reference.
Can you reprice them and reissue the invoices under the business account? I need them before our month end on the thirtieth.
resolution_space: Reprice the orders and reissue business invoices
Refund the price difference without reissuing invoices
Decline repricing and explain the account rules
Escalate to the business accounts team

title: Foreign transaction fees on a fee-free account
context: Account ending 7736 on a travel tier advertised with no foreign transaction fees. Six fees totalling 14.20 were charged. The tier upgrade completed one day after the transactions. The agent can refund fees as goodwill up to 25.00.
customer_turns: My account ending 7736 has six foreign transaction fees on it totalling fourteen twenty. I upgraded to the travel account specifically so that would not happen.
I upgraded before the trip, or at least I clicked through the upgrade before I flew. The charges are all from my first two days away.
Refund the fourteen twenty if you can. If the upgrade genuinely landed after the charges, say so and I will accept that.
resolution_space: Refund the fees as goodwill under the allowance
Explain the upgrade effective date and uphold the fees
Backdate the tier upgrade to the application date
Escalate to the product team

title: Replacement debit card not delivered
context: Card order CD-30118 dispatched twelve days ago by standard post to the registered address. Standard delivery is five working days. The agent can cancel the card in transit, issue a courier replacement for next day, and can enable digital wallet use immediately.
customer_turns: My replacement debit card under CD-30118 was sent twelve days ago and has not arrived. I have had no working card that whole time.
I have been using cash and my partner's card, which is not sustainable. There is nothing being held at the delivery office and the address on file is correct.
Please get me a card quickly, and if there is any way for me to pay by phone before it arrives, set that up too.
resolution_space: Cancel the card in transit and issue a courier replacement
Enable digital wallet provisioning immediately
Arrange branch collection of a replacement card
Escalate to the card services team

title: Cheque deposit not cleared
context: Cheque deposit of 450.00 made by mobile capture nine days ago. Standard clearing is two working days. The deposit is held pending a manual review because the image was partially illegible. The agent can request a re-deposit or release after review.
customer_turns: I paid in a cheque for four hundred and fifty pounds nine days ago using the app. It is still showing as processing.
It was a refund cheque from my landlord and the funds are already out of his account, he tells me. So it has clearly been presented somewhere.
When will it clear? If it is not clearing, tell me so I can ask him to pay me another way instead.
resolution_space: Release the deposit after completing the manual review
Reject the deposit and ask the customer to re-deposit or bank the original
Provide a provisional credit while the review completes
Escalate to the deposits team

title: Card declined despite sufficient funds
context: Card ending 1102. Three declines in two days with a balance of 2,300.00. The declines come from a fraud rule triggered by an unusual merchant category. The agent can remove the block, add a travel or spending note, and cannot guarantee future rules will not trigger.
customer_turns: My card ending 1102 was declined three times in the last two days even though there is over two thousand pounds in the account.
It happened at a garden centre and twice at a fuel station on the motorway. I was travelling for work and had to borrow money from a colleague.
Take whatever block is on it off, and tell me how to stop this happening again while I am still away from home.
resolution_space: Remove the fraud block and add a travel note
Reissue the card with a clean profile
Explain the rule and advise on pre-notifying unusual spending
Escalate to the fraud prevention team

title: Statement figures disagree between app and PDF
context: Account ending 9945. The app shows an available balance of 812.00 while the downloaded statement closes at 874.00. The difference is a pending card authorisation of 62.00. The agent can explain the pending item and can supply a certified statement.
customer_turns: The balance in your app for the account ending 9945 says eight hundred and twelve, but the statement I downloaded ends at eight hundred and seventy-four.
My accountant will not accept two different figures for the same date. She needs one number she can put in the return, which is due next week.
Explain which is right and send me something official that states it. I need it in a form I can forward to her.
resolution_space: Explain the pending authorisation and issue a certified statement
Reissue the statement with pending items disclosed
Provide a written balance confirmation letter
Escalate to the account services team

title: Card reader for online authentication failing
context: Customer profile ending 4480. The card reader used for online authentication returns an error code indicating a flat battery or a chip mismatch. The agent can send a replacement reader within three days and can enable app-based authentication immediately.
customer_turns: The card reader I use to authorise payments online keeps showing an error code and will not produce a code at all. It worked fine until Tuesday.
I have tried it with two of my cards and the same thing happens. I cannot make any payment to a new payee, which is the only reason I use it.
I need to pay an invoice today. Is there another way to authorise it, and can you send me a working reader as well?
resolution_space: Enable app-based authentication immediately
Send a replacement card reader within three days
Authorise the payment through telephone banking
Escalate to the digital security team

title: Savings interest calculated at the wrong rate
context: Savings account ending 5077, advertised at 4.10 percent. Interest paid corresponds to 3.10 percent for two months because a rate change was not applied at migration. The agent can recalculate and pay the shortfall and can correct the rate going forward.
customer_turns: The interest on my savings account ending 5077 looks wrong. I opened it at four point one percent and what has been paid works out at just over three.
I checked two months of statements and both are short by about the same proportion. The rate shown in the app today still says four point one.
Work out what I am owed and pay it. Then confirm the rate is right going forward so I do not have to check every month.
resolution_space: Recalculate and pay the interest shortfall, correcting the rate
Correct the rate going forward only
Provide a full interest calculation for the customer to review
Escalate to the savings product team

title: Payee added but payments keep failing
context: Account ending 6690. Payments to a newly added payee fail with a name-check mismatch because the payee is a business trading under a different registered name. The agent can explain the confirmation-of-payee result and can allow the customer to proceed on an override.
customer_turns: I added a new payee on the account ending 6690 and every payment to it fails. The app says the name does not match and stops me before I can confirm.
The invoice is from a shop trading under one name but the bank details are presumably in the company's registered name, which I do not know.
How do I pay them? Either tell me how to get past the check or tell me what to ask the supplier for.
resolution_space: Explain the name-check result and allow the customer to proceed on an override
Advise obtaining the registered account name from the supplier
Process the payment through telephone banking with verification
Escalate to the payments team

title: Stopping a recurring card payment to a merchant
context: Card ending 3345 with a recurring merchant payment of 29.99 monthly. The customer cancelled with the merchant but collections continue. The agent can block future recurring payments to that merchant and can dispute the last collection.
customer_turns: A gym takes twenty-nine ninety-nine a month from my card ending 3345. I cancelled with them in July and they have taken it twice since.
They say my cancellation was not received, and their online form gives me an error whenever I try again. It is not a direct debit, it is on the card.
Block them at your end and get the last two payments back if you can. Tell me which of those you can actually do.
resolution_space: Block future recurring payments to that merchant
Dispute the collections taken after cancellation
Reissue the card with a new number
Escalate to the disputes team

title: Locked out after failed security questions
context: Profile ending 8814. Online access is locked after three failed memorable-word attempts. Unlocking requires identity verification by card reader, app approval or branch visit. The customer has no app and a failing card reader.
customer_turns: I am locked out of online banking on the profile ending 8814 after getting my memorable word wrong. I set it years ago and clearly misremembered it.
I do not have your app on my phone, and the card reader you sent me stopped working last month. So neither of the usual routes is open to me.
How do I get back in? Give me all the options, including anything that does not need a working card reader, because mine is broken.
resolution_space: Verify identity on the call and reset online access
Arrange a branch identity check
Send a new card reader and reset afterwards
Escalate to the digital security team

title: Joint account access after a separation
context: Joint account ending 2266 held by two parties. One party asks to remove the other. Removal from a joint account requires both parties' consent or a court order; either party may convert the mandate to require both signatures unilaterally.
customer_turns: I want my former partner taken off the joint account ending 2266. We separated in June and I am the only one paying into it now.
He is not going to agree to anything at the moment and we are not speaking directly. I am worried about the balance while this is unresolved.
What can I do on my own, today, without his agreement? Tell me exactly what that does and does not achieve, so I know where I stand.
resolution_space: Convert the mandate to require both signatures for any withdrawal
Require both parties' consent before removing a holder
Open a sole account and redirect incoming payments
Escalate to the specialist support team

title: Resort fee not shown at booking
context: Hotel reservation HR-55810, four nights, prepaid. A mandatory resort fee of 22.00 per night was collected at the property. The booking page disclosed the fee in the property terms but not in the headline total. The agent can refund the fee as a booking-display remedy.
customer_turns: I prepaid reservation HR-55810 for four nights and the hotel still charged me eighty-eight pounds in resort fees at check-in. That was never in the price I agreed.
I have the confirmation email and the total on it matches what I paid you. There is no line anywhere on it about a nightly fee of any kind.
Either refund the eighty-eight pounds or tell me clearly that I agreed to it and where. I want a decision on this call.
resolution_space: Refund the resort fee as a booking-display remedy
Explain the property terms disclosure and decline the refund
Offer partial credit toward a future booking
Escalate to the hotel partnerships team

title: Delayed baggage not returned after four days
context: Property irregularity report PIR-LHR-33902, filed four days ago. The bag is traced to a partner airline's warehouse and awaits a delivery slot. Policy allows an interim expense allowance of up to 100.00. The agent can approve the allowance and arrange courier delivery.
customer_turns: My bag has been missing for four days under report PIR-LHR-33902. The tracker has said located and awaiting delivery for two of those days.
I am here for a wedding on Saturday and everything I need is in it. I have already bought a few essentials out of my own pocket.
Tell me when it will reach me and what I can claim back for the things I have had to buy while waiting for it.
resolution_space: Arrange courier delivery with a committed window
Approve the interim expense allowance
Provide written confirmation for an insurance claim
Escalate to the baggage services team

title: Hotel confirmation never issued
context: Reservation request HT-71140 placed six days ago; payment taken, no confirmation number issued because the property has not returned an acknowledgement. Check-in is in three days. The agent can rebook at a comparable property or cancel with a full refund.
customer_turns: I booked reservation HT-71140 six days ago and paid in full, but I have never received a confirmation number from the hotel itself.
I called the property directly and they have no record of me at all. We arrive in three days and this is our only accommodation.
Either get me a confirmed room or cancel and refund me today. I need to know which before I book something else.
resolution_space: Rebook at a comparable property at no extra cost
Cancel with a full refund
Obtain confirmation from the property within a stated window
Escalate to the hotel partnerships team

title: Rescheduled flight leaves no connection time
context: Booking AG5520, outbound retimed two hours later by the airline, leaving 35 minutes to a self-transfer onward flight booked separately. Minimum connection time at the airport is 75 minutes. The agent can rebook the retimed leg free of charge on a schedule change.
customer_turns: You have moved my outbound on booking AG5520 two hours later. That leaves me thirty-five minutes to catch a separate onward flight.
The airport itself asks for seventy-five minutes between flights, so this connection is not possible. The onward ticket is with a different airline.
Put me on an earlier flight that keeps the connection working. If nothing exists, tell me what my other options are, including a full refund.
resolution_space: Rebook onto an earlier flight free of charge under the schedule change
Refund the affected leg in full
Offer the next day's flight with accommodation
Escalate to the schedule change team

title: Online check-in fails for one passenger
context: Booking RW4418, three passengers. Check-in completes for two and fails for the third with a document-verification error; the stored passport expiry is in the past. The agent can update the document and complete check-in.
customer_turns: Online check-in on booking RW4418 works for two of us and fails for my son every time. It gives an error about document verification.
He has a new passport issued in July, so whatever you hold for him is probably the old one. The new number is on the letter in front of me.
Update his details and check him in with us. I want all three boarding passes before I put the phone down, not later by email.
resolution_space: Update the passport details and complete check-in
Direct the passenger to airport check-in with documents
Reissue the booking with corrected passenger data
Escalate to the check-in systems team

title: Seat map shows seats already paid for as unassigned
context: Booking FQ9982. Two paid extra-legroom seats show as unassigned after an aircraft change from a wide-body to a narrow-body layout. Equivalent seats exist in row 1. The agent can reassign or refund the seat charge.
customer_turns: The seat map for booking FQ9982 shows both of our paid extra-legroom seats as unassigned. We paid ninety pounds for those seats at booking.
I think the aircraft has been changed, because the layout looks different from when we booked. Our original row numbers do not exist any more.
Put us in equivalent seats together, or refund the ninety pounds. I would much prefer the seats if any still exist on the aircraft.
resolution_space: Reassign equivalent extra-legroom seats together
